pageSubtitle: Learn how to create interactive educational content with AI

whatIsEduNest.title: What is EduNest?
whatIsEduNest.description: EduNest is an AI-powered platform for creating courseware and problem-solving animations. Each animation comes with a dedicated AI teacher to explain the content.

example1.title: 1. Finding the Incenter of a Triangle
example1.description: An interactive animation that demonstrates how to find the incenter of a triangle by drawing angle bisectors.

example2.title: 2. Finding Intersection Points of Functions and Lines
example2.description: Adjust parameters to find where a function and a line intersect, with real-time visualization.

example3.title: 3. English Word Matching Game
example3.description: An engaging word matching game to help students learn English vocabulary through interactive gameplay.

aiTeacher.title: AI Teacher - Your Personal Learning Assistant
aiTeacher.description: The AI Teacher button is located in the bottom right corner of each animation page. Click it to start a conversation and learn about any concepts you don't understand, or explore extended knowledge. The AI teacher gradually learns your strengths and weaknesses to provide personalized tutoring.

prompt.title: How to Write a Prompt
prompt.intro: Write a clear and specific description of what you want to create. Here are some tips:
prompt.tip1: Be specific about the topic or concept you want to explain
prompt.tip2: Include details about the target audience (e.g., grade level)
prompt.tip3: Mention any specific examples or scenarios you want to include

examples.title: Example Prompts
examples.example1: Create an interactive animation showing how to find the incenter of a triangle by drawing angle bisectors. Include step-by-step visualization.
examples.example2: Build an animation where students can adjust parameters to find where a function and a line intersect, with real-time visualization of the intersection point.
examples.example3: Create an English word matching game where students match words with their definitions. Include scoring and feedback.

language.title: Select Output Language
language.description: Choose the language for your generated content. The AI will create animations in your selected language.

interaction.title: How to Interact with Generated Content
interaction.description: After generating content, you can interact with it using the AI Teacher button located in the bottom right corner of each animation page.

initialization.title: Initialization (1 minute)
initialization.description: The AI Guide needs about 1 minute to initialize when you first open it. Please be patient during this process.

questions.title: Ask Questions
questions.description: After initialization, you can ask questions about the current page content. The AI teacher will provide detailed explanations.

personalized.title: Personalized Learning
personalized.description: The AI teacher gradually learns your strengths and weaknesses through your interactions. It will provide personalized tutoring based on your learning progress and areas that need improvement.

freeTrial.title: Free Trial Credits
freeTrial.description: EduNest provides limited free usage credits to make AI education accessible to students and teachers worldwide.

benefit.title: Free Credits
benefit.description: New users receive free credits to try out the platform. This allows everyone to experience the power of AI-powered education.
